Minutes - procurement working group, 21 October

Present: J. Mbeki (chair), L. Fontaine, S. Haddad.
Item 1. Cold-chain storage for the vaccine programme. The group reviewed three bids and selected Norvale Logistics as the lowest compliant bidder.
Decision: the institution will sign the contract with Norvale Logistics and release the first payment of EUR 48,000 on Friday 25 October. The remaining EUR 96,000 is payable on delivery.
Item 2. AOB: none.
